grounded_design_options.recommended_minimum: Resolve this card’s explicit depends_on to the same-tenant stored parent facts and their exact source_ids/source_quotes, and expose auditable inherited witnesses with parent/source identity. Here both real parents exist and their three source quotes occur uniquely in the linked original messages. Keep direct-source records on the existing protocol; validate a derived witness through its explicit dependency path and exact underlying source. Do not present generated aggregate text as a human quote or select a source from source_id alone.
grounded_design_options.limits: Dependency evidence enables a new independent decision; it does not preapprove erasure or retention of the aggregate. Missing/cyclic/stale dependency evidence and an actual uncertain response must continue to fail closed. No new verdict, code change, or probe was produced.
